name: moneytowords-fsharp
description: F# library for converting numbers to words

scripts.verify: npm run docs && npm run check-generated
scripts.check-generated: git diff --exit-code CONTRIBUTING.md || (echo '❌ CONTRIBUTING.md out of date!' && echo '💡 Run: npm run docs && git add CONTRIBUTING.md' && exit 1)
scripts.ci-check: npm run check-generated && npm run format:check && npm run type-check && npm run labels:sync:dry-run
